fluff.overview: The Word of Blake Militia inherited ComStar's combined-arms organizational philosophy and its Star League-era equipment stocks, fielding infantry formations that ranked among the best equipped in the Inner Sphere during the Jihad. Jump infantry Level I formations gave Militia commanders a vertical mobility option for operations in dense urban environments, where the ability to bypass barricades and reach elevated positions provided tactical flexibility against insurgent forces resisting Protectorate authority. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that provide sustained suppressive fire, these troops anchor defensive positions with a volume of fire that discourages enemy movement in the open.
